items.description: A modern file manager that helps users organize their files and folders.
A cross-platform launcher that simply works
An Obsidian plugin that embeds Claude Code/Codex as an AI collaborator in your vault
Your platform team, as a service

A Python tool to visualize + enforce dependencies, using modular architecture 🌎 Open source 🐍 Installable via pip 🔧 Able to be adopted incrementally - ⚡ Implemented with no runtime impact ♾️ Interoperable with your existing systems 🦀 Written in rust

A minimalist Windows desktop sticky note tool. It puts a few quiet, usable, and unobtrusive sheets of paper on your desktop. Native WPF, with support for to-dos and Markdown.——极简 Windows 桌面便签工具。让桌面上有几张安静、可用、不会打扰人的纸。WPF 原生，支持待办与 Markdown。
A macOS clipboard workbench: text and pictures that land on the clipboard leave usable. 喵喵吧台：macOS 上的剪贴板工作台，文字和图片进了剪贴板就变成能直接用的样子。
An open-source, macOS text action popup for running custom scripts, AI actions, and extensible workflows on selected text.

Open-source AI agent workspace for iOS/iPadOS and Android. On-device Linux, terminal, code, Git and local web previews; BYOK cloud AI. iOS adds Notes, Canvas, CAD/3D, voice, Skill Hub and supported local models. Android alpha includes Office viewing and editing. iPad-first. 开源设备端 AI 智能体工作台。

Termul is Terminal Ultimate Manager a cross-platform desktop terminal manager built with Tauri and React. Organize terminals by workspace with persistent sessions, multiple shell, split panes, embedded browser tabs, and a built-in code & markdown editor.
Tiling that feels like it shipped with macOS. Works out of the Box, settings menu, in-app updates, native Desktops kept intact, Lua underneath. Accessibility only, never SIP.

Free, sub-second on-device AI dictation for macOS. Dual engines (Whisper + Parakeet) on Apple Silicon. Optional AI polish on your Mac with EG-1 or S1-mini by Superwhisper, Apple Intelligence (macOS 26), Ollama, or your own OpenAI/Gemini/Claude key. Snippets, custom words, no account, no subscription, audio never leaves your Mac.
One AI agent, everywhere you work — terminal, desktop, mobile, and your chat apps. Rust core.

Oyenza Studio (formerly Oyen Poni): a living notch (Dynamic Island) for Windows and Mac. Music with synced lyrics, a focus timer, a file shelf your phone can drop into, tasks, clipboard history and live system stats. Native Rust, free and open source.
